proposals.title: Replace broken NOAA solar-wind contracts
proposals.exactChange: Sandbox replacement of the two approved 404 endpoints with official NOAA operational summary products and evaluation of NOAA RTSW one-minute products for fuller plasma and magnetic data.
proposals.why: Both currently approved solar-wind endpoints return HTTP 404, while official NOAA summary and RTSW directories are current.
proposals.benefit: Restores magnetic-field and speed channels and creates a path to density, temperature, and pressure.
proposals.risks: Summary files have little history; RTSW files are large; parser contracts and units require tests.
proposals.defaultAction: No replacement; continue reporting failed approved feeds.

proposals.title: Add small NOAA operational summary companions
proposals.exactChange: Add candidate-only parsers for solar-wind magnetic field, solar-wind speed, 10 cm flux, and latest GOES X-ray flare summaries. Do not promote or substitute automatically.
proposals.why: These small official files were parseable in the current retrieval environment while larger approved files were not.
proposals.benefit: Provides low-volume health checks and quick current-state evidence beside full feeds.
proposals.risks: Companion summaries can omit history and fields; they must never masquerade as complete source replacements.

proposals.title: Add bounded GloTEC ionospheric adapter
proposals.exactChange: Create a sandbox parser with payload-size limits, regional sampling, source timestamps, TEC units, missingness masks, and explicit assimilated-model labelling.
proposals.why: The official NOAA GloTEC product directory remains available and the ionospheric channel is absent from approved live capture.
proposals.benefit: Adds total electron content for radio-propagation context and temporal comparison.
proposals.risks: Large payloads, storage growth, interpolation complexity, and risk of mislabelling an assimilated model as a direct station reading.
proposals.privacyConsent: Regional comparison must retain approximate-location defaults and remain project-private.

proposals.title: Add full raw-body evidence transport and workflow dispatch
proposals.exactChange: Provide a dispatchable Node 24 evidence job that preserves complete response bytes, HTTP metadata, SHA-256 checksums, idempotent dated output, and workflow artifacts outside the canonical branch.
proposals.why: The present web retrieval layer exposed only one complete approved-source row and could not preserve full bodies for large JSON or GeoJSON feeds.
proposals.benefit: Makes Night Watch reproducible and allows genuine raw-data receipts rather than partial excerpts.
proposals.risks: Workflow permissions, duplicate runs, artifact retention, payload volume, and location metadata require strict controls.
proposals.privacyConsent: Exact location must remain disabled unless separately approved; approximate configured location remains private by default.
proposals.defaultAction: Continue partial reports and do not claim full raw preservation.
